# **Fette Compacting.**
# Von der Formulierungs­entwicklung bis zur fertigen Tablette.

Als verlässlicher Partner mit mehr als 75 Jahren Erfahrung unterstützen wir Sie bei der Entwicklung
komplexer Prozesse.

[

Ob in der Entwicklung oder bereits in der Marktphase: Wir analysieren Ausgangsstoffe und Endprodukte
umfassend, um kritische Materialeigenschaften, Prozessparameter und Qualitätsmerkmale zuverlässig zu
identifizieren.

][72]
[

Wir unterstützen Sie bei der Entwicklung robuster Formulierungen durch die exakte Analyse von
Pulvereigenschaften und Tabletten – für eine stabile und reproduzierbare Produktqualität.

][73]
[

Durch die Verknüpfung von Pulver- und Kompaktierungsanalysen mit Tablettierversuchen identifizieren
wir gemeinsam mit Ihnen die kritischen Prozessparameter für Ihre Produktion.

][74]
[

Mit unserem Transferservice ermöglichen wir einen reibungslosen Übergang von Forschung und
Entwicklung zur kommerziellen Produktion – für eine schnelle Skalierung und flexible Anpassung an
Veränderungen.

][75]
[

Die Lieferung passender Maschinen und Werkzeuge aus einer Hand reduziert Schnittstellenprobleme,
vereinfacht den Produktionsprozess und spart Zeit und Kosten.

][76]
[

Durch gezielte Beratung, praxisorientierte Trainings und individuelle Modernisierungen optimieren
wir Ihre Produktionseffizienz und verkürzen die Produktentwicklungszeit.

][77]

###### R&D Solutions

Die Dosierräder erhöhen die Fließfähigkeit des Pulvers und sorgen für eine gleichmäßige Dichte.
Präzise Abfüllung und Dosierung reduziert den Produktverlust.

###### R&D Solutions

Expertise, Technologien und Services entlang des gesamten Entwicklungsprozesses – für schnellere
Innovation, hohe Produktqualität und mehr Effizienz bis zur Produktionsreife.

[ R&D Solutions ][78]

###### Production Solutions

Das Fette Compacting TRI.EASY-Design ermöglicht eine einzigartig einfache und sichere Bedienung. Die
Idee dahinter: Nur wenn Technik in den drei Dimensionen Betrieb, Umrüstung und Wartung gleichermaßen
einfach ist, kann sie effizient sein.

###### Production Solutions

Innovative und hocheffiziente Tablettenpressen – perfekt ergänzt durch Lösungen für Continuous
Manufacturing und Containment sowie Tablettierwerkzeuge, Prozess-Equipment und weitere Services.

[ Production Solutions ][79]

## Tableting

### The Product Range of a Specialist

KORSCH innovation will continue to drive the future of tablet compression. Innovations are born and
developed in Berlin, through technical curiosity and in close cooperation with science and industry.

#### Pharma

###### KORSCH produces the most comprehensive line of pharmaceutical tablet presses for R&D,
###### scale-up, high-speed, multi-layer technology, tablet-in-tablet, and containment.

#### Food & Confectionery

###### KORSCH offers tablet presses designed for food & confectionery applications such as
###### sweeteners, candies, chewing gum, nutraceuticals and effervescent products.

#### Chemical

###### Tablet presses engineered for chemical applications such as laundry detergent, dishwasher
###### tablets, salt tablets, fertilizer tablets, and chlorine tablets.

#### Technical

###### Tablet press solutions for technical applications including batteries, catalysts, airbag
###### components, magnets and sintered metal components.

About

## AARTI DRUGS LTD.

Aarti Drugs Ltd. was established in the year 1984 and forms part of $900 Million Aarti Group of
Industries with robust R&D Division at Tarapur, Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation
(MIDC) in close vicinity to manufacturing locations.
* The Company is engaged in the manufacturing of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), Pharma
  Intermediates, Specialty Chemicals and also produces Formulations with its wholly-owned subsidiary
  – Pinnacle Life Science Private Limited.
* Products under APIs includes Ciprofloxacin Hydrochloride, Metronidazole, Metformin HCL,
  Ketoconazole, Ofloxacin etc. whereas Specialty Chemicals includes Salicylic acid, Trimethylamine,
  Dimethylamine, Monomethylamine, Benzene Sulphonyl Chloride, Methyl Nicotinate etc.

About

## AARTI DRUGS LTD.

Aarti Drugs Ltd. was established in the year 1984 and forms part of $900 Million Aarti Group of
Industries with robust R&D Division at Tarapur, Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation
(MIDC) in close vicinity to manufacturing locations.
* The Company is engaged in the manufacturing of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), Pharma
  Intermediates, Specialty Chemicals and also produces Formulations with its wholly-owned subsidiary
  – Pinnacle Life Science Private Limited.
* Products under APIs includes Ciprofloxacin Hydrochloride, Metronidazole, Metformin HCL,
  Ketoconazole, Ofloxacin etc. whereas Specialty Chemicals includes Salicylic acid, Trimethylamine,
  Dimethylamine, Monomethylamine, Benzene Sulphonyl Chloride, Methyl Nicotinate etc.

## Exceptional Service, Competitive Prices & The Best Lead Times In The Industry.

America's Best Nutrition is a GMP certified supplement manufacturer servicing national and
international brands around the world.  Our product development specialists, formulators, analytical
chemists and marketing specialists have a strong understanding of all aspects of the dietary
supplement and natural medicine industry.  Above all, we are qualified to help you create the
best-in-class products you are looking for. Whether you are a major national brand looking for new
manufacturing partners, a small start-up looking for turn-key services, or anywhere in between,
America’s Best Nutrition can provide you with safe and effective products to help you achieve your
goals.

directly to your co-packer or packaged in-house at competitive rates.

exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one

[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

Marianna Bacellar-Galdino has always loved scientific research, and after a particularly eye-opening
project in veterinary school, ophthalmology became the thread connecting all her scientific
interests—and eventually her whole career.

[Watch now! ][19]

We are a forward-thinking, mid-size early phase contract research organization, in Canada and the
U.S., offering biopharmaceutical companies of all sizes a proven, flexible approach to early drug
development, including preclinical safety testing, clinical pharmacology (Phase I to Phase II),
bioanalysis (preclinical to Phase IV), research services, and manufacturing and analytical services.

Focused on your success … always available and always looking ahead ... moving in unison to deliver
big impact with a personal touch.

## WHAT WE DO

We help you reach early phase drug development decision-making milestones sooner, improving speed
and ease from lead candidate selection to proof of concept, and beyond.
* [ [Preclinical Services] ][20]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Preclinical Services ][21]
  
  Safety assessments for both small and large molecules
* [ [Clinical Services] ][22]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Clinical Services ][23]
  
  Clinical pharmacology trials from first-in-human to end of Phase II
* [ [Manufacturing and Analytical Services] ][24]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Manufacturing and Analytical Services ][25]
  
  From formulation development, Phase I through commercial manufacturing, and ICH stability testing
* [ [thumb] ][26]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Bioanalysis Services ][27]
  
  Package or stand-alone. Preclinical, Phase I to Phase IV bioanalytical laboratories
* [ [research support services] ][28]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Research Support Services ][29]
  
  Comprehensive CRO services to support clinical and preclinical studies

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody

debilitating diseases.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

## About BF-ESSE

**BF-ESSE operates two independent, EU-registered production lines dedicated to the manufacturing
and packaging of food supplements and nutraceuticals.**
Our facilities are engineered to meet contemporary quality standards (**[ISO 22000, HACCP][37]**),
ensuring safe, compliant and scalable contract manufacturing for European brands.
We specialise in capsules, powders, sachets, tablets, syrups and functional blends — offering fast
development, private-label manufacturing and export-ready packaging. **[Find out our story][38]**
We open our facility to professionals.

## We can develop a new product or use a ready-made formulation for your brand

**Private Label** products are developed to your exact technical specifications. **White Label**
products include one of our many available formulas, which is then launched under your distinct
brand identity.
[ [White lable food supplyment package ] ][40]
[ [White lable food supplyment package ] ][41]
**[What Is Private Label in Food Supplements?][42]**
[Private Label involves creating a food supplement product from scratch based on your specific
requirements. You define the formula, dosage, flavor, packaging design, and other key elements. It’s
the right choice for those looking to build a unique and personalized brand.][43]
**[What Is White Label in Food Supplements? ][44]**
[White Label means ready-made products created by a manufacturer that you can brand as your own.
There’s no need to develop a formula or design—simply choose the product and apply your logo. It’s
an ideal solution for a quick and easy market launch.][45]
**Trying to decide between custom formulations or ready-made products?**
Explore our comparison of **[private vs. white label supplements][46]** to see which model best
aligns with your product goals and brand vision.

## About BF-ESSE

**BF-ESSE operates two independent, EU-registered production lines dedicated to the manufacturing
and packaging of food supplements and nutraceuticals.**
Our facilities are engineered to meet contemporary quality standards (**[ISO 22000, HACCP][37]**),
ensuring safe, compliant and scalable contract manufacturing for European brands.
We specialise in capsules, powders, sachets, tablets, syrups and functional blends — offering fast
development, private-label manufacturing and export-ready packaging. **[Find out our story][38]**
We open our facility to professionals.

## We can develop a new product or use a ready-made formulation for your brand

**Private Label** products are developed to your exact technical specifications. **White Label**
products include one of our many available formulas, which is then launched under your distinct
brand identity.

**[What Is Private Label in Food Supplements?][42]**
[Private Label involves creating a food supplement product from scratch based on your specific
requirements. You define the formula, dosage, flavor, packaging design, and other key elements. It’s
the right choice for those looking to build a unique and personalized brand.][43]
**[What Is White Label in Food Supplements? ][44]**
[White Label means ready-made products created by a manufacturer that you can brand as your own.
There’s no need to develop a formula or design—simply choose the product and apply your logo. It’s
an ideal solution for a quick and easy market launch.][45]
**Trying to decide between custom formulations or ready-made products?**
Explore our comparison of **[private vs. white label supplements][46]** to see which model best
aligns with your product goals and brand vision.

## Enzymes

[Eznyme manufacturer-Biovencer]

Biovencer Healthcare is one of the leading enzyme suppliers, distributors & exporters in India.
Enzymes are biocatalysts that when present in a chemical reaction, increase the rate of a reaction
without affecting the property and nature of the end product. Almost all enzymes are proteins, but
not all proteins are enzymes.

reaction. Enzyme activity can be influenced by a change in pH, temperature, and the concentration of
substrate present and can be described by the Turnover Number. Our range of Enzymes that are
distinctive, reliable, and 100%  safe for consumption.

## Enzymes

[Eznyme manufacturer-Biovencer]

Biovencer Healthcare is one of the leading enzyme suppliers, distributors & exporters in India.
Enzymes are biocatalysts that when present in a chemical reaction, increase the rate of a reaction
without affecting the property and nature of the end product. Almost all enzymes are proteins, but
not all proteins are enzymes.

Enzymes are highly specific in their action; therefore, each enzyme catalyzes only one type of
reaction. Enzyme activity can be influenced by a change in pH, temperature, and the concentration of
substrate present and can be described by the Turnover Number. Our range of Enzymes that are
distinctive, reliable, and 100%  safe for consumption.

# Cultiply

¿Qué hacemos?

En Cultiply nos dedicamos a ofrecer una solución completa a todos aquellos clientes que buscan
desarrollar y producir bioproductos a través de la fermentación. Somos una **empresa que abarca todo
el ciclo de producción**, desde la idea inicial hasta la producción industrial, y estamos
comprometidos a ofrecer un servicio de alta calidad en todas las etapas del proceso.

Nuestro servicio incluye el **desarrollo de bioprocesos en escala laboratorio y piloto**, para lo
cual contamos con expertos en la materia y las tecnologías más avanzadas. Además, diseñamos
biorreactores adaptados específicamente a las necesidades de cada proyecto, permitiendo una
producción más eficiente y personalizada.

Nos enfocamos en brindar una solución integral a nuestros clientes, mediante la cual se cubren todas
las necesidades relacionadas con la fermentación. Esta visión 360º que ofrecemos a nuestros clientes
es lo que llamamos **“fermentación inteligente”**, un enfoque integral que nos permite abordar todos
los aspectos del proceso de producción, desde la fase de desarrollo hasta la producción en escala
industrial, asegurando siempre la máxima calidad y eficiencia.

Un "micromundo" de posibilidades

En Cultiply, trabajamos en la **intersección de la biología y la tecnología**, con el objetivo de
ofrecer soluciones sostenibles e innovadoras a nuestros clientes. Nos enfocamos en el estudio y
manipulación de microorganismos para crear productos de alto valor añadido. A través de la
fermentación y otros bioprocesos, podemos obtener compuestos como proteínas, enzimas,
biofertilizantes y otros derivados biológicos que pueden ser utilizados en diferentes industrias.

Nuestra experiencia en microbiología industrial nos permite entender y trabajar con la diversidad de
microorganismos, **desde bacterias hasta levaduras y hongos filamentosos**. Contamos con
instalaciones y equipos de última generación para llevar a cabo el desarrollo y la producción de
estos bioproductos de manera eficiente y efectiva.

**Nos adaptamos a las necesidades específicas de cada cliente**, desde la fase de desarrollo del
proceso hasta la producción en gran escala. Ofrecemos un servicio integral que incluye el diseño y
optimización del proceso, la ingeniería de biorreactores y la producción a gran escala. Trabajamos
en estrecha colaboración con nuestros clientes para lograr una producción sostenible y eficiente,
sin comprometer la calidad de los productos finales.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

Today, We Are

Paracetamol, being the safest & the most affordable Analgesic & Antipyretic drug, is used for

### Paracetamol DC Granules – Directly Compressible for Tablet Production

Our DC provides drum-to-feeder compression/encapsulation solutions that are both economically sound
and operationally simple.

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company.

## Our chain approach


The strength of our scheme lies in our unique chain approach. Safe and sustainable feed can only be
achieved when companies work together as a coherence within the feed chain. That's why all companies
from collection to production can be GMP+ certified. Because a chain is as strong as its weakest
link.

## Benefits of GMP+ Certification

### Unique chain approach


GMP+ certified companies do business with companies which are likewise certified. Because all
companies work according to the same standards, we create a uniform chain from collection to
production.

The GMP+ FC scheme has integrated HACCP and is based on ISO 22000 standards.

How it works

## Two sides publish. Hell of a Partner matches.

A brand posts the distribution it needs. A distributor posts the capability it offers. Hell of a
Partner scores the fit and brokers the introduction.

Manufacturer / Brand

Publishes a distribution offer
* Product lines to place
* Target markets to reach
* Sales channels to sell through
* Requirements for the right partner

### Hell of a Partner, the platform

It scores every distributor against each brand's offer on seven weighted criteria, then brokers the
introduction. Contact details stay private until the request is accepted.

Distributor / Importer / Agent

Publishes a capability profile
* Markets and territories covered
* Sales channels operated
* Customer base already served
* Product categories handled
* Certifications held

What makes it different

## Local and craft makers you won't find on the big networks

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around the small producers the transnational
marketplaces never list: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops, cooperatives and

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

We continually align our manufacturing capabilities with consumer trends—like options for vegetarian
soft gels. [Read More][59]

With our unique continuous manufacturing process IVC is best positioned to compete and innovate in
solid dose form. For example, people who have trouble swallowing tablets can benefit from our unique
plant-based Nutraglide™ coating, which makes pills easier to swallow. [Read More][60]

Two-piece capsules continue to grow in popularity because of their clean and efficacious delivery
method. IVC is one of the largest producers of vegetarian-friendly, plant-based capsules. [Read
More][61]

Delicious and simple to consume at all ages, IVC has the flexibility to make our gummies from
gelatin and/or pectin with formulas leveraging natural colors, flavors, sweeteners, and
preservatives. [Read More][62]

We produce powders for sports nutrition, whey and plant-based protein, meal replacement, fiber,
functional foods, and herbs. IVC can package powders in a variety of formats, including jars,
canisters, individual packages, gusset bags, and super sacks. [Read More][63]

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

# N F C tự hào là doanh nghiệp đi đầu trong sản xuất các loại thực phẩm sấy chất lượng cao theo hệ
# thống tiêu chuẩn quốc tế

Từ năm 2002, Công ty TNHH Thực phẩm N F C được thành lập và gia nhập thị trường thực phẩm bằng cách
cung ứng các thực phẩm sấy chất lượng cao cho thị trường Nhật Bản, sau đó là các giải pháp thực phẩm
cao cấp cho các tập đoàn lớn trong nước và quốc tế.

N F C tập trung vào giá trị cốt lõi là chất lượng và xem lợi ích khách hàng là then chốt, cùng với
tầm nhìn dài hạn và phát triển thị trường toàn cầu, chúng tôi không ngừng phát triển để ngày càng
lớn mạnh, đáp ứng tốt cho nhu cầu khách hàng và đóng góp vào sự phát triển của xã hội.

### Vải sấy thăng hoa


## Vải sấy thăng hoa

 
* **Kích thước:** Dạng nguyên miếng, dạng mảnh hoặc dạng bột theo yêu cầu.
  
  **Đặc điểm:** Giòn xốp, nhẹ, vị ngọt thanh và hương thơm đặc trưng của vải chín.
  
  **Thành phần:** Vải chín tự nhiên, không bổ sung đường hóa học và không sử dụng chất bảo quản.

[Liên hệ ngay
][13]

Trong xu hướng sử dụng nguyên liệu trái cây tự nhiên, tiện lợi và có thời gian bảo quản dài, vải sấy

## Vải sấy thăng hoa

 
* **Kích thước:** Dạng nguyên miếng, dạng mảnh hoặc dạng bột theo yêu cầu.
  
  **Đặc điểm:** Giòn xốp, nhẹ, vị ngọt thanh và hương thơm đặc trưng của vải chín.
  
  **Thành phần:** Vải chín tự nhiên, không bổ sung đường hóa học và không sử dụng chất bảo quản.

[Liên hệ ngay

Trong xu hướng sử dụng nguyên liệu trái cây tự nhiên, tiện lợi và có thời gian bảo quản dài, vải sấy
thăng hoa đang được nhiều doanh nghiệp lựa chọn để phát triển bánh kẹo, đồ uống,… Nhờ công nghệ sấy
trong môi trường chân không, sản phẩm giữ được hương thơm đặc trưng, vị ngọt thanh và cấu trúc giòn
xốp của vải tươi. Nature Foods cung cấp vải sấy theo nhiều quy cách, từ nguyên miếng, dạng mảnh đến
dạng bột, đồng thời hỗ trợ gia công OEM/ODM và đóng gói theo yêu cầu.

## **Tổng quan về sản phẩm vải sấy Nature Foods**

Vải sấy thăng hoa Nature Foods được sản xuất từ những quả vải đạt độ chín phù hợp, có phần thịt dày,
vị ngọt tự nhiên và hương thơm đặc trưng. Sau khi được sơ chế, bóc vỏ và loại bỏ hạt, nguyên liệu
được cấp đông nhanh trước khi chuyển vào hệ thống sấy chân không.

Quá trình này giúp loại bỏ phần lớn lượng nước trong quả mà hạn chế tác động của nhiệt độ cao. Nhờ
đó, thành phẩm có kết cấu nhẹ, giòn xốp, dễ sử dụng và thuận tiện trong quá trình bảo quản, vận
chuyển hoặc phối trộn.

Tùy theo nhu cầu của khách hàng, [Nature Foods][14] có thể cung cấp:
* Vải sấy thăng hoa nguyên miếng.
* Vải sấy dạng mảnh hoặc kích thước nhỏ.
* Bột vải sấy dùng trong sản xuất thực phẩm và đồ uống.
* Sản phẩm đóng gói công nghiệp hoặc gia công bao bì riêng.
* Quy cách dành cho phân phối bán lẻ, quà tặng hoặc thương hiệu riêng.

Sản phẩm phù hợp với các nhà máy thực phẩm, phòng R&D, chuỗi đồ uống, thương hiệu thực phẩm lành
mạnh, doanh nghiệp phân phối và đơn vị cần tìm nguồn **vải thiều sấy khô** ổn định quanh năm.

## **Đặc điểm nổi bật của vải sấy thăng hoa**

So với nguyên liệu vải tươi, vải sấy thăng hoa có nhiều đặc điểm thuận lợi cho hoạt động sản xuất và
kinh doanh.

[Đặc điểm của vải sấy thăng hoa - Nature Foods]Ảnh minh họa: Đặc điểm của vải sấy thăng hoa – Nature
Foods
* **Giữ hương vị tự nhiên:** Hương thơm và vị ngọt thanh đặc trưng của vải được duy trì tương đối
  tốt sau khi sấy.
* **Kết cấu giòn xốp:** Thành phẩm nhẹ, giòn, dễ ăn trực tiếp và dễ nghiền hoặc cắt nhỏ.
* **Độ ẩm thấp:** Giúp hạn chế nguy cơ hư hỏng nhanh và thuận tiện cho việc lưu kho.
* **Dễ phối trộn:** Có thể sử dụng ở dạng nguyên miếng, mảnh nhỏ hoặc bột trong nhiều công thức thực

* **Trọng lượng nhẹ:** Hỗ trợ tối ưu chi phí vận chuyển và phân chia định lượng.

## **Tổng quan về sản phẩm vải sấy Nature Foods**

Vải sấy thăng hoa Nature Foods được sản xuất từ những quả vải đạt độ chín phù hợp, có phần thịt dày,
vị ngọt tự nhiên và hương thơm đặc trưng. Sau khi được sơ chế, bóc vỏ và loại bỏ hạt, nguyên liệu
được cấp đông nhanh trước khi chuyển vào hệ thống sấy chân không.

Quá trình này giúp loại bỏ phần lớn lượng nước trong quả mà hạn chế tác động của nhiệt độ cao. Nhờ
đó, thành phẩm có kết cấu nhẹ, giòn xốp, dễ sử dụng và thuận tiện trong quá trình bảo quản, vận
chuyển hoặc phối trộn.

Tùy theo nhu cầu của khách hàng, [Nature Foods][14] có thể cung cấp:
* Vải sấy thăng hoa nguyên miếng.
* Vải sấy dạng mảnh hoặc kích thước nhỏ.
* Bột vải sấy dùng trong sản xuất thực phẩm và đồ uống.
* Sản phẩm đóng gói công nghiệp hoặc gia công bao bì riêng.
* Quy cách dành cho phân phối bán lẻ, quà tặng hoặc thương hiệu riêng.

Sản phẩm phù hợp với các nhà máy thực phẩm, phòng R&D, chuỗi đồ uống, thương hiệu thực phẩm lành
mạnh, doanh nghiệp phân phối và đơn vị cần tìm nguồn **vải thiều sấy khô** ổn định quanh năm.

kinh doanh.

[About us][30]

**The Ultimate All-in-One Encapsulating system with great features**

Two stations spread out the molten gel across cooling drum. The gel hardens into a solid continuous
sheet. Each sheet passes over a rotating die with capsule shape cavities. Just before the two gel
sheets come together, pump injects the required quantity of material solution into each cavity.

The pressure pushes the gelatin into each cavity. At the same time, the machine heats the gel
sheets, so that when they meet, they adhere to each other, forming full capsules with material
solution sealed inside. In the final second, the dies’ sharp edges slice the gel caps free and they
fall to a conveyor belt below.

[About us][30]

**The Ultimate All-in-One Encapsulating system with great features**

Two stations spread out the molten gel across cooling drum. The gel hardens into a solid continuous
sheet. Each sheet passes over a rotating die with capsule shape cavities. Just before the two gel
sheets come together, pump injects the required quantity of material solution into each cavity.

The pressure pushes the gelatin into each cavity. At the same time, the machine heats the gel
sheets, so that when they meet, they adhere to each other, forming full capsules with material
solution sealed inside. In the final second, the dies’ sharp edges slice the gel caps free and they
fall to a conveyor belt below.

### About our parent company

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the

### About Conference



**Conference Series!!** Cordially invites participants from all over the world to
attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &
Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

**WHO SHOULD ATTEND?**

The conference invites Directors, Group Leaders, Professors, Associate Professors, Lecturers,
Research Associates, Scientists, Investigators,  business delegates from Leading Universities,
Pharmaceutical companies, Formulation Scientists, Medical Devices, Researchers, Health care
professionals, across the globe providing a better podium, interconnecting the latest research,

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

## **Unlock the science of softgel capsules**

#### Your soft capsule development, amplified by our independent expertise.

[ Learn more ][38]

### **We are experts in the development of soft capsules.**

Backed by more than 30 years of experience, we use a systematic approach to understand your softgel
product better. Our approach focuses on the critical aspects of softgel development to help you
produce robust soft capsules.

Schedule a call with us and find out how we can support your softgel development project.

[ Contact us ][39]

### **The challenge**

#### Outsourcing softgel capsule development often brings confusion and a lack of insight into the
#### process.

### **Our solution**

#### With our background in prominent pharmaceutical CDMOs, we bring transparency and expertise to
#### navigate the complexities of your soft gel development.

# **Why work with us** 

Despite a century of industrial production, softgel capsules remain poorly understood. Each
formulation presents unique challenges, demanding expertise in excipients, processes, analysis, and
regulations for success. Bringing together the best practices in soft gel development, we stand as
independent experts with real solutions.

#### **Mitigate development risks **

Avoid risks in the development process. We consider critical aspects for the entire capsule from day
one following our structured, risk-based approach tailored for soft gel capsules.

[Yellow checkmark inside a yellow circle on a black background.]

#### **Become the expert for your soft gel product**

We support you in finding the critical factors for your softgel product and ensure complete
development documentation. With our expertise, our team is there to empower your product.

[Gold checkmark icon inside a circular border.]

#### **Prepare state-of-the-art CMC documentation**

Uncertain about regulatory expectations, or which agencies to see? We enhance your soft gel CMC
documentation and prepare CMC sections for your IND/IMPD file in CTD format.

[A gold check mark inside a gold circle on a black background.]

#### **Get the right partners on board**

Optimize your sourcing strategy and lead efficient negotiations with our extensive partner database
for the development and analytical services of soft gel capsules.

[Yellow checkmark inside a yellow circle on a black background.]
[ Learn more ][40]

### **Who we are**

We are a team of pharmaceutical scientists with more than 30 years of experience in the CDMO space,
bridging all crucial aspects for successful softgel development. Over the years, we've assisted
numerous customers in developing, manufacturing, and bringing soft gel products to market in the EU
and USA. Our portfolio encompasses over 50 softgel capsule projects.

[ Learn more about us ][41]

#### **DISCOVER OUR NEW ONLINE COURSE**

# **Become the expert for your softgel product**

Most of what matters in softgel development is learned over years of trial and error, not from
textbooks. Our on-demand course gathers that practical knowledge, such as formulation,
manufacturing, and quality control, into one place, taught by someone who has led more than 50
softgel projects. It offers the following:

[Yellow checkmark inside a yellow circle on a black background.]

#### **Industry expertise**

A complete view of softgel technology, from lipid-based fill formulation and shell development
through to manufacturing and quality control.

[Yellow checkmark inside a yellow circle on a black background.]

#### **Practical solutions**

Literature-backed strategies to develop stable formulations and prevent the defects that tend to
surface again and again in production.

#### **Regulatory grounding**

A clear handle on the pharmacopeial and non-pharmacopeial testing methods, plus the regulatory
expectations specific to softgels.

[A gold check mark inside a gold circle on a black background.]

#### **On-demand learning**

Every lesson is a video you can watch, pause, and revisit at your own pace, so the course fits
around the work you already have.

[Yellow checkmark inside a yellow circle on a black background.]

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.
